kjv: For the fruit of the Spirit
note: TR "pneumatos" (from Gal 5:22) against "photos" (P46, Sinaiticus, A, B, D*, F, G), which fits the light imagery of 5:8–14.

kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God
mine: submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ
note: TR "theou" against "Christou" (P46, Sinaiticus, A, B). In the early text 5:22 has no verb of its own and depends on this participle, so mutual submission frames the household code; the KJV supplies "submit yourselves" in 5:22.

kjv: members of his (Christ's) body, of his flesh, and of his bones
note: TR adds "ek tes sarkos autou kai ek ton osteon autou" from Gen 2:23; absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B.
